view_meta: the shared object-group editor — named host-glob sets the policy and credential engines both union into a target's group membership (spec/016, TG-481)
purpose: OBJECT GROUPS surface (spec/016, TG-481): the missing console half of the object-group store — the API (GET /v1/estate/groups, POST /v1/estate/groups/entries, DELETE /v1/estate/groups/entries/{id}) shipped with no operator UI. Lists every hand-authored group (id, name, host-glob patterns, precedence, creator, created-at) from the live, persisted estate_object_group table; adds one group (name + at least one pattern + rationale — precedence is fixed to the sole ratified value 'union'); removes one group (mandatory rationale — taking a group back is a decision, not a cleanup). The read sits at the elevated AuthTraceRead tier (membership reveals actuation-policy structure) and both writes at AuthAdminSession — this mirrors the credentials module's native-mapping sub-surface exactly: the same elevate-on-403 read state, the same ledger-first add/delete, the same verbatim validator text on refusal. The grounder never writes estate_object_group itself: both writes proxy through the worker's ledger-first objectgroup.ObjectGroupWriteWorkflow (temporal/objectgroup), which validates and ledgers the change BEFORE the row commits.
notes: Honesty contract: NO fixture — every value is fetched live, lazily, on first render (module-local ogList state, not liveState/liveAdopt — the read is elevated exactly like credentials/native and needs the SAME status-code-aware 403 handling, which a shared liveAdopt-chain fetch would lose). Unauthenticated shows only the auth gate; authenticated, a 403 renders the honest elevated-read state with a step-up affordance (never sample rows), a timeout/401/other failure renders its own honest reason with RETRY, and an empty store renders an honest empty state, never a fabricated row (INV-15). Per-row rationale is deliberately NOT displayed as a column — the read model (httpapi.ObjectGroup) does not carry it; each write's rationale is folded into the governance ledger's Reason text instead, and the view's intro says so. Precedence is rendered as fixed text, not a free-entry field: validPrecedence() accepts only 'union' today, so an editable field would just be a guaranteed-400 trap for anything else typed into it. Reuses the console design system verbatim: wrapcard/tbl/sec/empty components, the map-plane (machine) color token for pattern chips, the same theme tokens — no new palette beyond a two-circle 'union' nav glyph. Deliberately NO rail badge: this read is AuthTraceRead-only (mirrors credentials/native, which also carries none) — a badge only a subset of operators could ever see live would either lie for everyone else or sit permanently at '—', which is what omitting it already reads as honestly.
verified: assemble.py rebuild byte-clean; node --check on the extracted bundle passes; hash-route #objectgroups registers and renders (empty/error/elevated-read/loaded states exercised against a stubbed API); e2e/object-groups-editor.mjs drives the write half — real-data list rendering (not fixture-fallback, since none exists), 403 elevated-read honesty, add validation + success with the exact POST payload + verbatim 400, delete rationale-required + success + 404-already-removed honesty, and the shared admin step-up modal on a 401 write.
